MCS2026_Commodities_Data: USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries 2026 (MCS 2026) data release, published by the U.S. Geological Survey National Minerals Information Center (DOI 10.5066/P1WKQ63T). Tidy, long-format table (about 8,900 rows) extracted from the commodity chapters of the report, covering 89 chapters / 127 commodities (nonfuel minerals and materials, including Rare Earths, Rare Earths (Heavy), Yttrium, Scandium and the individual lanthanides) for 2021-2025. Each row is one statistic for one commodity, country and year. Two kinds of rows: (1) Section 'Salient Statistics-United States': U.S. production, imports, exports, consumption, stocks, prices, employment and net import reliance for 2021-2025 (2025 values are estimates); (2) 'World Mine Production and Reserves' and similar 'World ...' sections: mine/refinery production and reserves by country, mostly 2024 and 2025 (2025 estimated), plus 'Import Sources' rows giving the share of U.S. imports by source country for the 2021-24 period. Columns: 'MCS chapter' (uppercase chapter name), 'Section', 'Commodity' (e.g. 'Rare Earths', 'Rare Earths (Heavy)', 'Yttrium', 'Neodymium'), 'Country' (a country, 'United States', 'World total' or 'Other countries'), 'Statistics' (Production, Reserves, Import, Export, Consumption, Price, Net import reliance, Employment, Capacity, Stock, 'Import sources 2021-2024', etc.), 'Statistics_detail' (specific measure, e.g. 'Mine production', 'Imports: Compounds', 'Price, average, dollars per kilogram: Neodymium-praseodymium (NdPr) oxide, 99% minimum'), 'Unit' (e.g. metric tons, dollars per kilogram, percent), 'Year' (2021-2025, or '2021-24' for import sources), 'Value', 'Notes', 'Is critical mineral 2025' (Yes/No, per the 2025 U.S. critical minerals list) and 'Other notes' (chapter-level unit notes such as 'Data in metric tons unless otherwise specified'). For rare earths, filter Commodity = 'Rare Earths' (about 130 rows): world mine production and reserves for Australia, Brazil, Burma, Canada, China, Estonia, Greenland, India, Japan, Madagascar, Malaysia, Nigeria, Russia, South Africa, Tanzania, Thailand, the United States and Vietnam (rare-earth-oxide equivalent, metric tons); U.S. imports/exports of compounds and metals; NdPr oxide and mischmetal prices (dollars per kilogram); net import reliance; and U.S. import sources by country. Caveats: Value is stored as text, with thousands separators and non-numeric codes such as 'NA' (not available), 'W' (withheld to avoid disclosing company proprietary data), 'E' (net exporter), 's' (less than half the unit shown), '-' (zero or not applicable) and ranges like '>50' or '<1,000'. Always check Unit, Year and Notes before quoting a number, and do not add 2025 estimates to earlier actual figures without saying so. Rows for helium and rare gases (argon, neon, krypton, xenon) are unrelated to rare earth elements.
